name: Log
description: This keyword will return the log of the selected series of the particular instrument. Log keyword is generally used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the log of the selected series of the particular instrument. Log keyword is generally used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632228703.png)

The above condition will return log of previous day's NIFTY 50 close price

Log keyword used in Tradetron is part of Numpy library - https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.log.html
